summary: Added a health dashboard and JSON API under `src/health-dashboard/`, wired `health.ubq.fi/` and `/api/health` into the worker before VPS proxying, documented configuration, and added thorough tests. No actionable correctness defects were found in the introduced code.

evidence: `src/health-dashboard/page.ts` serves the dashboard HTML that renders overall and per-service test statuses, links, refresh, and unavailable states.
`src/health-dashboard/api.ts` aggregates GitHub Actions workflow runs for configurable app and plugin repositories via `HEALTH_CHECKS` and exposes a public CORS-enabled `/api/health` snapshot.
`src/worker.ts` routes `health.ubq.fi/` and `/api/health` to the dashboard while preserving `/__health` liveness and existing VPS paths.
`README.md` and `tests/health-dashboard.test.ts` document and exercise routing, configuration, status semantics, caching, error handling, and page rendering.
